plugin.name: Save Loader
loadslot.description: The save the game loads when it starts. Hold Shift while the game starts to go to the main menu instead.
skiploading.description: Doesn't draw the loading screens, which makes loading faster in San Andreas.
skipoutro.description: Vice City quits without showing its closing screen.
userfiles.description: A folder in the game's folder for saves and the game's settings, for example "save". Empty: the game's folder in Documents.
